scope: Evidence for the first corridor carry checkpoint (20261101T010729, final iteration 299): 256 held-out corridors and cabinet masses (new seed, training ranges) with pursuit and the checkpoint on the same seeded starts, including walking speed; plus four showcase corridors (narrow heavy left, narrow heavy right, wide light left, medium right), each built twice so pursuit and the checkpoint run the same corridor, recorded at 10 fps from an oblique camera placed relative to each corridor corner, with per-decision traces.
